case_title: RAHUL v. STATE OF DELHI MINISTRY OF HOME AFFAIRS & ANR.
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to death penalty
neutral_facts: A girl was kidnapped while returning from her job along with her friends. She was raped and killed later, and her body was thrown in an open field. An FIR was registered against the accused. The trial court convicted and sentenced them to death, which was confirmed by the High Court. However, the Supreme Court found that the identity of the accused was not properly established, the arrest and identification process had serious doubts, and the evidence was not sufficiently proven. The prosecution failed to establish the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt, leading to their acquittal.
